COMPARISON ANALYSIS

Small-commercial time-of-use with demand charge vs Tiered small-commercial energy plan

Both are commercial rate structures, but they behave very differently. Small-commercial time-of-use with demand charge is best for shave peak, while Tiered small-commercial energy plan favors rightsize plan.

Feature Small-commercial time-of-use with demand charge Tiered small-commercial energy plan
Rate StructureTOU DEMANDTIERED
Peak Window16:00-21:00 weekdaysNA
Demand Charge BandMIDNONE
Fixed Charge BandMIDLOW
Primary Action LeverSHAVE PEAKRIGHTSIZE PLAN
Common MisreadOwners shift load into off-peak hours but restart everything at once, resetting the peak.Owners assume the higher block price applies to all usage rather than the marginal block.

🎯 The Verdict

If your business has high, concentrated usage during peak hours, Tiered small-commercial energy plan will likely save you money. Always verify your specific load profile before requesting a rate change from your utility.
